_doc: Per-product Tesco listing overrides + constants. Edited by the /tesco-shopify-shape skill, read by scripts/mirakl_bq_to_tesco.py and scripts/tesco_csv_batch.py. Tesco categories ARE the Shopify product taxonomy; attribute schema is API-discoverable via /products/attributes?hierarchy=<gid>.

exclude_skus.C-SP22144: No sellable Tesco leaf for a trailer (2026-06-09)

attribute_extras._doc: Extra Tesco attribute values to inject into rows. Shape: {attrCode: {SKU_or_'*': value}}. '*' applies to every product; a SKU key wins over '*'. Use for category-specific required attrs (e.g. batterySize) that aren't auto-filled.
